verdict.rationale: Unleash can be self-hosted anywhere via Docker, giving customers full control over where data resides, and Unleash Edge keeps PII local to the Edge node rather than sending it to Unleash Cloud. However, there's no explicit documentation of a managed/cloud offering letting users pick a specific hosting region, nor any dedicated data-residency/compliance page. missing for 10: explicit cloud region selection options, formal data residency/compliance documentation, evidence of multi-region hosted infrastructure.
